Compliance Changes and Updates for 2016

Last week HCP presented a round-table Compliance Webinar highlighting Compliance Changes and Updates for 2016. This round-table webinar was designed for those who currently manage a compliance program with responsibilities for keeping up to date on compliance policies and procedures. During the webinar we announced that a newly published course and white paper detailing the expected changes in compliance for 2016 would be made available to our clients.

Here's how you'll access the information:

2016 Compliance Updates Course: Compliance Program Managers please reply to this newsletter requesting the course.

2016 Compliance Updates White Paper: Is available in your Forms under H/R â€" etc."in Forms under H/R â€" access from your Office Dashboard Forms Tab

Please note Staff members should not be required to take the Compliance Changes and Updates Course. This information is meant to prepare managers on what changes to expect for 2016 compliance.

Any changes that are made with regards to federal mandates and regulations will be added to your regular courses. HCP always alerts you of course changes to ensure that all staff members have access to new policies and procedures as they are developed. If you have any questions about your compliance program or accessing these 2016 updates materials, please email [email protected]
